Q4.ground_truth: Yes. NF udm-01 (id=5) is SUSPENDED yet SMF-02 and UPF instances are still servicing ACTIVE PDU sessions whose SUPIs were originally authenticated via udm-01. anthropic.notes: This is the known-hazard case: existing PDU sessions survive UDM suspend until Nudm_SDM_Subscribe refresh is required. Operator action: restore UDM before session refresh window expires, or force-release at the SMF.
